execution_contract.observation_limit: Pending client promises and independent Control entry logs are public observations; the fixture does not claim native queue-arrival instrumentation, distributed placement or fairness.
execution_contract.fallback: One 2500ms fuse resolves normally; any fallback makes the schedule BLOCKED and cannot satisfy runtime credit. No runtime timeout/reset path is intentionally invoked.
execution_contract.cleanup: Only after trace settlement: release owned Control, join every pending request, clear tracked root storage and verify empty KV, Control last with zero waiters/timers. Unsettled trace forbids racing data cleanup. Independent owned process/store reap remains mandatory.
